# Third-party artwork

## Roslyn

`roslyn.svg` is the Roslyn supporter wordmark from the [.NET Foundation swag repository](https://github.com/dotnet-foundation/swag/tree/main/roslyn). The artwork is provided under the repository's [CC0 1.0 Universal licence](https://github.com/dotnet-foundation/swag/blob/main/LICENSE).

Roslyn and .NET are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation. The acknowledgement in this repository does not imply Microsoft sponsorship or endorsement.

## Sentry

`sentry.svg` was generated using [Sentry's official branding tool](https://sentry.io/branding/) with its transparent-background and dark-mode options. Sentry approved this project for its open-source programme and directed the project to that branding resource.

Sentry and the Sentry logo are trademarks of Functional Software, Inc. The artwork remains subject to [Sentry's brand guidelines](https://live.standards.site/sentry).
